name: Guerrero

standard.note: Guerrero's current plate carries the state government's 'Transformando Guerrero' logo and a QR code at the top, maroon-and-gold tones, and the national and state seals at the bottom.

plates.title: Current design
plates.fact: Guerrero's current plate carries the state government's 'Transformando Guerrero' logo and a QR code at the top, maroon-and-gold tones, and the national and state seals at the bottom.

notes: Could not reach sefina.guerrero.gob.mx (blocked from this environment) and found no official plate artwork on guerrero.gob.mx or the state broadcaster rtg.com.mx (only photos of offices). Start year not confirmed: the 'Transformando Guerrero' design was already described in an Aug 2023 UnoTV article, so it dates from about 2022-2023 (Evelyn Salgado administration). Photos show it in both a white version with a maroon lower band and a maroon-background version. A white design with a colorful embroidered-textile border ('Automovil privado') also appears in 2025 news photos; I could not establish whether it is older or newer, so it is not listed. No specialty plates found.
